text:
8.3.2 Configurable interfaces definitions for interaction with upper layer mod-
ule
Since the API description now has a generic approach, the serviceIds of the upper
layer API functions are generic as well. To differentiate between several upper lay-
ers, the PduR uses the moduleIds of the upper layer modules as the instanceId
argument in the Det call originated from APIs listed in this section.

targets.why: BSW standardized C application programming interfaces
Standardized callback interfaces to upper layers
